summary: The loss that makes friends: Weeks after you lost {the wider race}, {party official} you met on the trail calls about {open seat} nearer home.
realLife: One life: At 27 he lost the 2010 Indiana treasurer race badly after a year of county fairs and diners; party leaders he met helped when he won the South Bend mayoralty the next year. Another: He lost his first race in 1832 but carried his own town almost to a man. Another: He lost a 1974 race for Congress and was elected Arkansas attorney general, unopposed, two years later.
gates: Ties with party leaders made in that race are on record.
weights: How well you did in your home area.
